text_block_list.text: The day after her debut race concluded—

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Reporter
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you today, Mihono Bourbon-san.
A reporter from an Umamusume magazine came to visit Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Reporter
text_block_list.text:
—That was a magnificent debut race.
You really blew us all away.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Reporter
text_block_list.text: And so, may I ask about your future outlook...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The ultimate objective is achieving the Classic Triple Crown—meaning victories in the Satsuki Sho, Japanese Derby, and Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Huh, is that so!?
I totally thought you were aiming for the sprint route!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm taking the Classic route.
Winning the Triple Crown has been my dream since I was little.

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Reporter
text_block_list.text: I see, so through repeated training, you've calculated that you can compete in medium and long-distance races as well?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I don't have that much confidence yet.
I believe my aptitude lies strictly in short distances.

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Reporter
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

Mihono Bourbon looked back at the bewildered reporter
with a puzzled gaze of her own.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Reporter
text_block_list.text:
No, um... if that's the case,
I usually wouldn't make that kind of choice...

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Reporter
text_block_list.text:
It could lead to injury,
and above all, it's such a waste.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Achieving the Triple Crown is non-negotiable.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Because of that, I build up stamina through daily training to withstand the pursuit of the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Reporter
text_block_list.text: I-I see...

The reporter left, looking somewhat unconvinced.
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"The big newcomer Mihono Bourbon, once anticipated
to be the future Sprint King.
Her goal is unexpectedly the Triple Crown."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"‘Fans who had high hopes for her performance
have expressed bewilderment.’"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Analysis complete.
In other words, would this be considered 'criticism'?
choice_data_list: You don't have to worry about it.
You don't need to worry about it.

text_block_list.text:
"The claim that it's 'voices from the fans' is also suspicious.
That reporter might have just made it up."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However—earlier, while running the perimeter,
I received several comments along similar lines.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Audio data, playback.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"It's better to compete in what you're best at.
For your own sake, I want you to reconsider."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Forcing yourself to run is dangerous.
I'm telling you this only because I care about you."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Apparently, after seeing the article, they were waiting for me to come out of the school.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Judging by the reactions of the press,
it appears they consider it somewhat reckless after all.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It's not that it bothers me, per se,
but the extent of it was unexpected.
choice_data_list: You even went out of your way to lie in wait for me...

text_block_list.text: Actually, this wasn't the first time something like this had happened.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh?! Mihono Bourbon going for
the Classic Triple Crown?! What a waste!
Why isn't she doing sprint races?!"

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: "About Mihono Bourbon... Is she going to be all right with such intense training?"

text_block_list.name: Former Trainer
text_block_list.text: "...You should be competing in sprints, Bourbon."

Though without ill intent, it was as if
no one trusted Mihono Bourbon's judgment in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Lowered eyebrows, tension around the mouth.
Confirming "Sadness" from Master's facial expression.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Master, why do you feel "sadness"?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Is this 'frustration' something that can be resolved through my own efforts?

I wondered how best to explain it
to a bewildered Mihono Bourbon.
It's not Mihono Bourbon's fault. It's just that without results, people won't put their trust in you.
Then—
choice_data_list: ...If we can prove it in the next target race...

text_block_list.text: If she can achieve results that convince everyone she's worthy of aiming for the Triple Crown—

The way people look at Mihono Bourbon
might just change after this.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, our next target race,
the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes,
is a 1,600-meter mile race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Compared to the Classic Triple Crown, the distance
is too short. Will that be enough to convince you?
choice_data_list: As long as you prove you're a strong Umamusume, that's enough.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A strong... Umamusume?

It makes you feel that even with the distance extended,
her speed never waned until the very end.

"Let's show that level of strength and tenacity
in the Asahi Hai FS." When I said that—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Analysis shows Master desires
a performance that will satisfy everyone.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order received. At the Asahi Hai FS,
I will execute the directive: 'Win over the public.'

And so, days spent entirely on training
for the Asahi Hai FS began!
